title: High-speed fiber broadband
text: Fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) broadband for individuals, families, students and shared apartments: speed tiers from everyday to premium, unlimited data with a transparent fair-use policy where one applies, symmetrical upload and download where the network supports it, and low latency for gaming, video calls, work from home, online classes, streaming and many devices at once.

title: Internet plans and upgrades
text: Plans range from basic (browsing, studying, social media) and standard (everyday household use) to high-speed (4K streaming, heavy downloads, many users), gaming-optimized (latency-sensitive players) and premium (power users, smart homes). Temporary speed boosts for downloads, events or special occasions where technically feasible (the Speed boost day pass), upgrades and downgrades any time, and custom plans for high-demand households.

title: Wi-Fi and home networking
text: A router comes with installation depending on the plan; optional Wi-Fi 6 or newer router upgrades; mesh Wi-Fi for larger homes; Wi-Fi coverage assessment and optimization (the Home Wi-Fi checkup); device connection management; guest Wi-Fi setup help; parental controls and device scheduling (Family Shield); basic home network security guidance; router diagnostics and remote troubleshooting where supported; advice on router placement and fixing dead zones.

title: Internet diagnostics
text: Real-time connection status, speed tests, latency and ping tests, jitter and packet-loss checks, Wi-Fi signal and coverage diagnostics, router health checks where supported, data usage if the plan has any limit, connection history with recurring-issue detection, and personalised tips to improve performance.

title: Installation and maintenance
text: Availability check for your address, new connection booking, installation appointment scheduling, technician visit tracking, installation status updates and activation confirmation, relocation when you move home, router replacement and equipment service, fiber cable damage reports, and repair or maintenance appointments.

title: Gaming-optimized connectivity
text: Gaming plans and low-latency network configuration where supported (Gaming Boost), connection quality monitoring for online games, ping, jitter and packet-loss diagnostics, help reducing lag and improving Wi-Fi, gaming network troubleshooting, Ethernet and router recommendations, and congestion diagnostics where our network can see it. These are diagnostics and recommendations, never a guaranteed ping.

title: Game-specific connection checks
text: Pick your game (Valorant, Counter-Strike 2, BGMI, Call of Duty, Fortnite, Apex Legends, League of Legends and other multiplayer games) for a tailored check: estimated latency to its servers, server-region advice, connection quality, packet loss and jitter, help with sudden ping spikes, game server outage news when reliable data exists, and stability tips. Server location, routing and the player's own device all affect results, so no particular ping is promised.

title: Gaming dashboard
text: A gaming section in the customer portal: a connection health score, ping and latency history, network stability reports, gaming support tickets, game server status, recommended network settings, gaming plan comparisons and gaming offers and rewards.

title: Gaming perks and community
text: Gaming subscription offers through authorised partners, accessory discounts, esports tournament announcements, community events, challenges and rewards, referral rewards for gamers, promotions during big gaming events, and gaming cafe or esports venue partnerships. Specific paid subscriptions, in-game currency or exclusive perks are only offered once the partner agreement exists, so none are named yet.

title: OTT bundles
text: Broadband plans bundled with selected streaming subscriptions, premium entertainment add-ons, family bundles and optional streaming packages, monthly or longer where available, with a clear comparison of standalone versus bundled cost and plain information on what is included, for how long, and who is eligible. Partner categories: movies, TV, regional-language entertainment, live sports and international streaming. Specific platforms are named only after partnerships are confirmed.

title: OTT subscription management
text: One place to see the streaming benefits your plan includes, activation instructions, renewal and expiry reminders, eligibility checks, help when activation fails, guidance on linked accounts, and upgrades or downgrades of streaming add-ons.

title: Entertainment discovery
text: Recommendations based on what you tell us you like: movies and series across supported platforms, regional-language picks, family-friendly suggestions, new-release and new-season alerts, watchlist ideas, and help finding what your existing subscriptions already include. Availability changes by platform, region and tier, so we name the platform and never promise a title is available without checking.

title: Streaming quality support
text: Help with buffering and playback interruptions, streaming speed and connection diagnostics, 4K streaming advice, device compatibility, Wi-Fi tuning for smart TVs, support for several streams at once, and streaming service outage news where available.

title: The Hub, one dashboard
text: The Hub is the customer portal's control panel: your plan and speed, connection status, speed test and diagnostics, router and devices where supported, data usage if it applies, billing and payment history, upcoming payments and renewals, streaming benefits, gaming diagnostics, open support tickets, technician appointments, service announcements and outages, upgrade suggestions, promotions and rewards, and account and security settings. It only shows what applies to your account.
